author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Made By the Charmy Build Team!
http://imgur.com/a/szOfE Coliseum Map.
YML: Coming Soon
Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?jei532no3y9999l
This map was supposed to be based off Romes Coliseum but we changed it and made it our own map. The teams are Yellow, Red, Blue, and Green. They all spawn on one side of the map and you can move around. CTH everyone can go for mid and the archers can shoot in the towers. NebulaTDM u can run around and kill people. The Spawns are well protected. U can't Shoot people falling down nor shoot into spawn. Same for Nexus too!
Special Thanks to _garrett_rocks_ for assistance!

replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
My opinions:

The lava and soul sand is annoying an unnecessary. Also, note that the middle is extremely flat and lacks and texture, which makes gameplay quite bland. Most of the shapes are also very basic and blocky. Too add on, I think the towers will block extra space to pvp, which is currently occupied by the lava, soul sand, and ice (three hardest blocks to pvp on/around).

You should add others structures and textural blocks like stairs, slabs, etc to help counter its grey nature.

kthxbai

replies.author: PublixEmployee
replies.body:
I'm not feeling it too much, the map just looks too small. The spawns are too close to each other, and the water in the middle can be annoying for PvP at times. When you get stuck in it you can get screwed over majorly, so it can be a negative when you're making a PvP map.

I also honestly just don't like the look, it doesn't look that good in my opinion. 

I'm also not a fan of the spawn kits, full iron armor is just a bit too OP when making a TDM map. I'd prefer to see something more like: Leather helmet, leather chestplate, iron pants, leather boots.  
 
 As for the CTH side, I do not like how the blocks in the middle go up for you to get on point. I like most maps that have a smooth feeling to it where I can spawn and go straight to the middle and not have to deal with something as little as jumping up to get on it.
